WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY "segment"
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        ("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") AS "increase",
        
        (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2013") * 100 AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM pivoted
)

SELECT
    'biggest' AS "category",
    "segment",
    "consumption_2012",
    "consumption_2013",
    "increase",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM changes
ORDER BY "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL

consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        y."customerid",
        SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y."date", 4) = '2012' THEN y."consumption" END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(y."date", 4) = '2013' THEN y."consumption" END) AS consumption_2013

    WHERE LEFT(y."date", 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY y."customerid"
)

    c."customerid",
